tasks.title: A difficult-conversation plan and review
tasks.goal: Use the supplied fictional case. Try an answer aloud or in a short note before comparing with the worked example. The full worksheet is optional. Dana wants the document frozen today; Lee wants to revise its introduction. They are peers, and the shared purpose is accurate information by Friday noon. A full rewrite needs two hours; only thirty minutes remain. A factual correction needs twenty minutes. The organiser decides release scope.
